descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your chair. Your needles. Your reputation.

REAL TATTOOING, LINE BY LINE
Grab the stencil from the thermal printer and press it onto your customer's forearm - the purple transfer appears right where you put it. Dip the rotary pen in black and trace it. The machine buzzes to life the moment the needle touches skin. A light touch draws a fine line, a firm press lays a bold one, and pushing too deep makes your customer wince.

PACK THE COLOUR
Switch to the coil machine, dip it in each ink the design calls for and fill it in. Wipe away the excess with a paper towel and see your work come through clean and bright.

CUSTOMERS WITH THEIR OWN ORDERS
Nine different customers walk in with a design picked from your flash wall. They chat while you work, react when it hurts, and look down at the finished piece before they pay. Lining, colour packing, colour match, clean edges and a gentle hand all count - and great work earns big tips and a photo on your Wall of Fame.

BUILD YOUR SHOP
Each day brings new customers and new designs to master. Your money and reputation are saved between sessions.

SANDBOX
No orders, no score, unlimited ink. Pick any customer and any design, print the stencil or stamp the finished tattoo straight on, laser it off and start again.

A PARLOUR WITH ATMOSPHERE
Exposed brick, a red neon sign over a wall of classic flash, a leather waiting sofa, warm Edison bulbs and a cobbled street at night outside the window - with your own shop radio playing.
